env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# Each consumer must be rejected by both checked-source output paths.
# Keep cases outside the module so eject checks only the selected consumer.
cd m
cp ../direct.lgo main.lgo
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/direct$GOEXE .
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_(mutation|escape)\]'
! logos eject -o $WORK/direct-out
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_(mutation|escape)\]'

cp ../header.lgo main.lgo
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/header$GOEXE .

! logos eject -o $WORK/header-out
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_(mutation|escape)\]'

cp ../nested.lgo main.lgo

# Detached inline slots and independent mutable storage remain writable.
cp ../ok.lgo main.lgo
logos build -o $WORK/bin/ok$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/bin/ok$GOEXE
cmp stdout ../want.txt
logos eject -o $WORK/ejected
cd $WORK/ejected
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOPATH/src/want.txt

-- want.txt --
alias-controls-ok
-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/aliasmatrix

go 1.27

require example.com/aliasdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/aliasdep => ../dep
-- m/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type Inner struct {
	L []int
}

type Box struct {
	M map[string]int
	N int
	A [2]int
	Inner Inner
}

const Root = Box{M: map[string]int{"a": 1}, N: 7, A: [2]int{11, 13}, Inner: Inner{L: []int{17, 19}}}
-- dep/go.mod --
module example.com/aliasdep

go 1.27
-- dep/dep.go --
package dep

// Alias does not mutate its parameter, but its result is not independent.
func Alias(xs []int) []int { return xs }

func Write(xs []int) { xs[0] = 99 }
-- m/values.lgo --
package main

type Inner struct {
	L []int
}

type Box struct {
	N int
	A [2]int
	Inner Inner
}

const root = Box{N: 7, A: [2]int{11, 13}, Inner: Inner{L: []int{17, 19}}}
-- direct.lgo --
package main

import "unsafe"

func main() {
	*unsafe.SliceData(root.Inner.L) = 99
}
-- header.lgo --
package main

import "unsafe"

func main() {
	xs := root.Inner.L
	*unsafe.SliceData(xs) = 99
}
-- nested.lgo --
package main

import "unsafe"

func main() {
	outer := &root.Inner
	copy := *outer
	*unsafe.SliceData(copy.L) = 99
}
-- chain.lgo --
package main

import "unsafe"

func main() {
	p := unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(root.Inner.L))
	q := unsafe.Add(p, unsafe.Sizeof(int(0)))
	xs := unsafe.Slice((*int)(q), 1)
	xs[0] = 99
}
-- mutable.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/aliasdep"

func main() {
	dep.Write(root.Inner.L)
}
-- returned.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/aliasdep"

func main() {
	xs := dep.Alias(root.Inner.L)
	xs[0] = 99
}
-- imported.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/aliasmatrix/lib"

func main() {
	outer := &lib.Root.Inner
	outer.L[0] = 99
	copy := lib.Root
	copy.M["a"] = 99
}
-- address.lgo --
package main

func main() {
	outer := &root.Inner
	p := &outer.L[0]
	*p = 99
}
-- arrayslice.lgo --
package main

func main() {
	xs := root.A[:]
	xs[0] = 99
}
-- string.lgo --
package main

import "unsafe"

const text = "protected"

func main() {
	p := unsafe.StringData(text)
	xs := unsafe.Slice(p, len(text))
	xs[0] = 'X'
}
-- ok.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"unsafe"
	"example.com/aliasdep"
	"example.com/aliasmatrix/lib"
)

func main() {
	// Reference-free aggregate assignment is a value copy.
	a := root.A
	a[0] = 23
	// Addressing inline slots yields fresh variables, locally and imported.
	n := &root.N
	*n = 29
	e := &root.A[1]
	*e = 31
	in := &lib.Root.N
	*in = 37
	ie := &lib.Root.A[1]
	*ie = 41
	whole := &root
	whole.N = 43
	whole.A[0] = 47
	imported := &lib.Root
	imported.N = 53
	imported.A[0] = 59
	if a != [2]int{23, 13} || *n != 29 || *e != 31 || *in != 37 || *ie != 41 {
		panic("detached slots")
	}
	if whole.N != 43 || whole.A != [2]int{47, 13} || imported.N != 53 || imported.A != [2]int{59, 13} {
		panic("detached aggregate")
	}
	if root.N != 7 || root.A != [2]int{11, 13} || lib.Root.N != 7 || lib.Root.A != [2]int{11, 13} {
		panic("constant changed")
	}
	// Known unsafe observations are legal when they do not expose writable aliases.
	if *unsafe.SliceData(root.Inner.L) != 17 || *unsafe.SliceData(lib.Root.Inner.L) != 17 {
		panic("slice observation")
	}
	if unsafe.Slice(unsafe.SliceData(root.Inner.L), 2)[1] != 19 {
		panic("readonly slice observation")
	}
	if *unsafe.SliceData(root.Inner.L[1:]) != 19 {
		panic("readonly offset observation")
	}
	if unsafe.String(unsafe.StringData("read"), 4) != "read" {
		panic("string observation")
	}
	// The same unsafe chain and Go calls work on independent mutable storage.
	xs := []int{61, 67}
	p := unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(xs))
	q := unsafe.Add(p, unsafe.Sizeof(int(0)))
	unsafe.Slice((*int)(q), 1)[0] = 71
	dep.Write(xs)
	ys := dep.Alias(xs)
	ys[0] = 73
	if xs[0] != 73 || xs[1] != 71 || root.Inner.L[0] != 17 || lib.Root.Inner.L[1] != 19 {
		panic("mutable control")
	}
	fmt.Println("alias-controls-ok")
}
